templates.why_chosen: TreeVQA Controller is a dashed hub box holding stacked-card spokes C_i/C_k/C_j; a thin connector drops one spoke (C_j) down into a magnified detail panel showing its optimize/split decision loop.
templates.what_to_learn: Draw spokes as small stacked cards, a shorthand for identical parallel instances, inside a dashed hub boundary, then pick exactly one spoke and connect it with thin lines to a magnified panel below that spells out its internal decision logic with a Yes/No diamond.

templates.why_chosen: An open pipeline feeds a boxed TreeVQA Controller loop where cluster cards iterate and split, and a zoom callout below expands one cluster's Yes/No decision with a diamond box, the open-pipeline-into-boxed-loop shape.
templates.what_to_learn: Draw the repeating stage as one dashed boxed container (stacked cluster cards) fed by an open input pipeline, and pull the internal iterate/split decision out into a separate zoomed callout below with its own diamond Yes/No box rather than crowding it into the main diagram.

templates.why_chosen: Stacked VQA-cluster cards (C_i, C_k, ellipsis, C_j) sit inside a dashed TreeVQA Controller box, with one card, C_j, linked by thin connectors to a zoomed panel below showing exactly how that instance decides to split.
templates.what_to_learn: Draw the replicated instances as stacked cards inside one coordinator box, then link exactly one of them by a thin connector to a separate zoomed panel that details its internal decision logic (here a Yes/No split diamond), instead of drawing that logic inside every card.
